propositions: The lifespan's shutdown drain waits only on the webhook queue, leaving in-flight reconciler reviews unprotected and cancelled within 10s regardless of the 1200s drain budget.
Any non-autodeploy container stop (manual restart, host reboot, rollback) kills a reconciler review with no drain because the reconcile task runs inline outside the queue.
The drain must block new reconciler reviews from starting during shutdown to prevent indefinite extension of the grace period while still awaiting in-flight work.
Both the queue drain and the reconciler review drain share a single shutdown_drain_seconds budget bounded by the stop_grace_period to preserve the existing timing relationship.
The reconciler's shutdown path must record skipped candidates in held_back to preserve the cursor low-water-mark invariant and avoid dropping gap patchsets.
